place_name: Panorama Point (Valdez Glacier Campground / Airport Heights, Valdez, AK)
approach_stated: Approach time is 10-15 min.
from: car (parking at runway end, Valdez Glacier Campground)

evidence.fact: Park where campground road dead-ends at runway; Old Jeep Trail 1/4 mile then switchback trail; 'Approach time is 10-15 min.'

note: Single-pitch sport/trad cliff above Valdez airport runway. MP lists 'Firing Line, The' and 'Nose Knows, The' (article inverted) for The Firing Line / The Nose Knows.

place_name: Raspberry Rock (Blueberry Lake State Recreation Site, Thompson Pass, AK)
approach_stated: The wall is located ... immediately off the drive. You will be able to see bolts from the car.
from: car (paved drive into Blueberry Lake State Park)

evidence.fact: Small single-pitch wall 'a hundred feet off the paved drive'; bolts visible from the car. Roadside.

note: Roadside. MP lists 'Mental Block, The' (article inverted).

place_name: Republic of Boulder (Worthington Glacier State Recreation Site, Thompson Pass, AK)
approach_stated: Approach time is about 25 minutes.

evidence.fact: Park at Worthington Glacier lot, paved path, cross glacier stream, trail up drainage to cliff; 'Approach time is about 25 minutes.'

note: Single-pitch sport crag near (not on) Worthington Glacier; approach crosses a glacial outflow stream, no glacier travel. 'My Subaru Love's the Environment' left null: MP spells it 'My Subaru Loves the Environment' (Sport).

place_name: The Sunny Side (Worthington Glacier State Recreation Site, Thompson Pass, AK)
approach_stated: Approach time is about 25 minutes.

evidence.fact: Park at Worthington Glacier lot, paved path, tyrolean over outflow stream, cairned trail with scree; 'Approach time is about 25 minutes.'

note: Back side of the Republic of Boulder buttress; tyrolean traverse across the glacier outflow stream, no glacier travel.

place_name: Tiekle Wall (Tiekel River, Richardson Highway, AK)

evidence.fact: Visible from Richardson Hwy across the Tiekel River; 'follow the old highway as close... then hike from there' - no time stated.

note: No walking time stated. Route page: base of Mount Tiekle beside a major avalanche gully; 2-pitch route, rappel with a single 60 m rope.

place_name: Tsaina River Gorge Wall (Tsaina Bridge, Richardson Highway, AK)
approach_stated: Walk for two miniuts to the top of the wall then turn left. All routes are reached by means of a rapell.
from: car (pullout on Richardson Hwy past Tsaina Bridge)

evidence.fact: Park on Richardson Hwy near Tsaina Bridge; faint trail, 'Walk for two miniuts to the top of the wall'; routes reached by rappel.

note: Gorge crag reached by rappel from the top, 2 min from the road.

place_name: The Tunnel Wall (Old Railway Tunnel, Keystone Canyon, Richardson Hwy, AK)
approach_stated: The approach time is 1 minute.
from: car (large pullout at the Old Railway Tunnel)

evidence.fact: 100' wall overlooking the parking pullout at the Old Railway Tunnel, Keystone Canyon; 'The approach time is 1 minute.'

note: Roadside sport crag.

place_name: Valdez Glacier Campground Wall (Airport Rd, Valdez, AK)

evidence.fact: 'Closest sport crag to Valdez'; park at campground entrance, trail 'goes directly to the base of the walls' - no time stated.
Park on north side of the entrance Y and 'follow the trail head back about 200ft to reach the lower wall.' Distance only.

note: Only a distance (about 200 ft) is stated, no time; by the no-conversion rule this stays unsure, though effectively roadside. Scanned 12 MP route pages: none state a time. MP lists 'Good Book, The' and 'Little Waterfall That Could, The' (article inverted).

place_name: Worthington Ridge Trail Routes (Worthington Glacier SRS, Thompson Pass, AK)

evidence.fact: From Worthington Glacier lot follow the ridge trail 'about 3/4 miles and 500 vertical feet' - distance only, no time.
'The Ridge Trail is currently closed due to extreme rock slide danger'; no Ridge Trail time given.

note: Distance only. The approach trail (Worthington Glacier Ridge Trail) is reported closed for rockslide danger; MP warns not to approach from the glacier.

place_name: The Wedge (Chugach State Park, via Glen Alps / Powerline Pass trail, Anchorage, AK)
approach_stated: At least a 2 hour approach but you can make it shorter by riding bikes to the Hidden Lake turnoff.

evidence.fact: Glen Alps lot, Powerline Pass trail to Hidden Lake turnoff, up valley and talus; 'At least a 2 hour approach'; 'A full day adventure'.

note: Approach >60 min stated.

place_name: Mount Prindle Main Wall (White Mountains NRA, north of Fairbanks, AK)
approach_stated: the approach just to the base of the primary climbing areas is 3-4 hours
from: car (end of 4x4 road; drive is two hours from Fairbanks)

evidence.fact: Remote; 4x4 encouraged; 'the approach just to the base of the primary climbing areas is 3-4 hours.'
Thin Mint pulls a roof 'onto the summit area'; then about 100 ft of class 3 to the summit proper.

note: 900 ft wall on Mount Prindle's south headwall; summit finish on Thin Mint/Giradelli linkup.

place_name: Mount Prindle Southeast Buttress (White Mountains NRA, AK)
approach_stated: the approach just to the base of the primary climbing areas is 3-4 hours

evidence.fact: Mount Prindle parent area: 'the approach just to the base of the primary climbing areas is 3-4 hours.'

note: Time is stated for the Mount Prindle area as a whole (parent page), which includes this buttress.

evidence.fact: Mountain Project now returns 'Page Not Found' for this area (Fairbanks > Yukon River/Rapids area); the Fairbanks area no longer lists a Yukon sub-area.

note: Area deleted from MP; route names Impossible gold / Janitors Closet / Sloppy Joe not found on MP search or the web. Nothing stated about the approach.
